## History

Stimson was a local woman whose late-night search for a lost knitting needle inadvertently frightened the Meredith children. Draped in white sheets while crawling along the [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden dyke, her appearance led [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) to mistake her for the ghost of [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md). Her innocent action caused a panic among the children until [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) investigated the scene and revealed the embarrassing truth.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P4](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P5](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XXX.
